title: Clopen coefficient pullbacks, tensors and units
statement: Fix the purity coefficient datum [def-pur-conventions] and work on the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. For schemes $X,Y$ over $k$ and a morphism $j:Y\to X$ over $k$, define the integral, rational and common-stage pullbacks to be the existing constructible derived pullbacks [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] [def-pur-integral-derived-operations], supplying the residue-field invertibility of $\ell$ implied by the fixed setting. Define the three tensor functors to be the completed integral tensor and its rationalized and common-stage tensors from the same derived operations. The integral coefficient unit on $X$ is the actual completed regular coefficient module [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients] in degree zero, regarded as a constructible object by [lem-weil-constant-coefficient-objects-constructible]. Its rational unit is its image under the raw rational localization [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi]. For every finite coefficient stage $B$ in the fixed algebraic closure, its common-stage unit is the pair consisting of $B$ and the rational image of the completed regular module over that stage [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. These are specializations of the existing operations, with no additional comparison isomorphism or equivalence asserted.
